projects.title: 10th Session of ARFSD
projects.location: Addis Ababa • UNECA Regional Forum & Audiovisual Production
projects.venue: United Nations Conference Centre, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
projects.client: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA)
projects.summary: Case study: 10th Session of the Africa Regional Forum on Sustainable Development (ARFSD) for UNECA at the United Nations Conference Centre, Addis Ababa. Audiovisual production, simultaneous translation, live switching, and photography for 1,700+ participants.
projects.challenge: The 10th Session of the Africa Regional Forum on Sustainable Development brought together high-level policymakers, experts and development partners to address progress towards the 2030 Agenda and Agenda 2063. With both in-person and virtual participation and a multilingual audience, the forum required reliable audiovisual infrastructure and clear communication across the programme.
projects.solution: Eternal provided an integrated technical solution combining audiovisual systems, multilingual translation and live production support. The approach was designed to keep presentations, discussions and proceedings clear and accessible across the physical and virtual event environment.

approach.title: Strategy
approach.description: We developed a technical production approach around the forum’s hybrid format, multilingual audience and high-level programme, prioritizing clear communication and reliable event delivery.

approach.title: Concept
approach.description: A unified event environment connecting the physical venue, virtual audience and multilingual proceedings through coordinated audiovisual and translation systems.

approach.title: Design
approach.description: Screen and sound systems were configured for the United Nations Conference Centre, supported by simultaneous translation in four languages to facilitate communication across the forum.

approach.title: Production
approach.description: Eternal delivered the event’s screen, sound and translation systems, alongside live switching and technical coordination to support the programme throughout the three-day forum.

approach.title: Experience
approach.description: The technical setup supported a diverse audience of more than 1,700 participants, enabling clear presentations, discussions and multilingual proceedings across the hybrid event.

approach.title: Content
approach.description: Live switching and event photography documented the forum while supporting its live production and visual coverage, capturing key moments from the programme and its participants.

info.label: Audience
info.value: 1,700+ participants, including policymakers, experts, development partners and other stakeholders from across Africa

info.label: Scope
info.value: Technical production and event support for a three-day regional forum held in hybrid format.

projects.title: Empowering Startups in Ethiopia
projects.tagline: Stage Design • Event Production • Show Design
projects.summary: Case study: Empowering Startups in Ethiopia. Stage design, comprehensive event production, and technical direction in Addis Ababa.
projects.challenge: Ethiopia’s startup ecosystem was entering an important period of growth, with increasing attention on entrepreneurship, innovation and the systems needed to help startups scale. The event needed a setting that could give this emerging community a strong platform while supporting a high-level programme and its participants.
projects.solution: Eternal developed an event environment that combined stage design, show design and production into one cohesive experience. The approach positioned the stage as the central visual element of the gathering while creating a professional setting for dialogue, presentations and engagement.

approach.title: Strategy
approach.description: We shaped the production around the event’s focus on entrepreneurship and innovation, creating a stage environment suited to a high-level gathering of startups and ecosystem stakeholders.

approach.title: Concept
approach.description: A contemporary event environment designed to place entrepreneurs and their ideas at the centre of the experience, giving the programme a strong and cohesive visual identity.

approach.title: Design
approach.description: Eternal developed the stage design and visual structure of the event, balancing presentation requirements with a distinctive production aesthetic that reflected the forward-looking nature of the gathering.

approach.title: Production
approach.description: 72-hour surgical build within a sensitive historic industrial monument.

approach.title: Experience
approach.description: OThe finished environment created a professional platform for presentations, conversations and engagement, giving participants a setting that reflected the significance of Ethiopia’s emerging startup ecosystem.

approach.title: Content
approach.description: The event environment was designed to translate effectively across photography and event documentation, capturing the stage, speakers and wider gathering as part of the project’s visual record.

info.label: Audience
info.value: Startups, entrepreneurs, ecosystem stakeholders and government representatives

info.label: Scope
info.value: Creative stage design and event production for a high-level gathering focused on strengthening Ethiopia’s startup ecosystem.

projects.title: SDG Finance Academy 2024
projects.location: Addis International Convention Center (AICC), Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
projects.venue: Addis International Convention Center (AICC), Addis Ababa
projects.summary: Case study: SDG Finance Academy 2024 at Addis International Convention Center (AICC), Addis Ababa. High-definition audiovisual production, stage architecture, acoustics, and live event engineering.
projects.challenge: Convening multilateral financial institutions, sovereign funds, and policymakers to unlock scalable financing mechanisms for Sustainable Development Goals across Africa requires immaculate production. Technical interruptions or unclear acoustics directly hinder bilateral negotiations and high-stakes commitments.
projects.solution: Eternal delivered an integrated technical environment featuring calibrated acoustic engineering, synchronized multi-display digital scenography, stage architecture balancing formal diplomacy with dynamic presentation, and zero-latency live feeds.

approach.title: Strategy
approach.description: Aligning technical infrastructure with high-level multilateral protocol and bilingual breakout sessions.

approach.title: Scenography
approach.description: Stage architecture configured with high-lumen digital backdrops and dynamic architectural lighting.

approach.title: Acoustics
approach.description: Precision line array sound reinforcement ensuring pristine speech intelligibility across the expansive hall.

approach.title: Production
approach.description: Hardware deployment with redundant power systems, video switching, and multi-microphone matrix controls.

approach.title: Experience
approach.description: A frictionless atmosphere where delegates engage directly without acoustic strain or distractions.

approach.title: Documentation
approach.description: High-definition archival video capture and session photography preserving milestone commitments.

info.label: Audience
info.value: Institutional Investors, Finance Ministers, Multilateral Delegates

info.label: Scope
info.value: Full-scale audiovisual infrastructure, stage lighting, acoustic line arrays, and hybrid recording.

projects.title: Amhara Bank Anniversary Event
projects.summary: Case study: Amhara Bank Anniversary Event in Addis Ababa. Immersive experiential architecture, stage production, lighting design, and live event direction.
projects.challenge: Commemorating a flagship banking institution's journey requires an experience that honors cultural heritage while articulating modern financial leadership. The event needed to orchestrate vast attendee numbers across dinner ceremonies, live performances, and high-level corporate addresses without losing emotional intimacy or momentum.
projects.solution: Eternal crafted a panoramic stage environment infused with warm architectural lighting, multi-layered visual scenography, and immersive acoustic dispersion. Custom cultural motifs were rendered in dynamic digital animations, providing an awe-inspiring backdrop for an unforgettable anniversary evening.

approach.title: Heritage
approach.description: Interweaving traditional iconography with modern architectural lines to celebrate corporate legacy.

approach.title: Scenography
approach.description: Curvilinear stage contours featuring multi-tiered displays with high-contrast cinematic content.

approach.title: Illumination
approach.description: Warm amber and golden washes creating a majestic, celebratory banquet environment.

approach.title: Production
approach.description: Integrated control surfaces directing live musical performances, stage cues, and protocol speeches.

approach.title: Experience
approach.description: An emotionally resonant atmosphere that united thousands of stakeholders in collective celebration.

approach.title: Broadcast
approach.description: Multicam recording, live feed broadcast switching, and cinematic post-event highlight reels.

info.label: Audience
info.value: Shareholders, Banking Executives, Institutional Partners, Public Dignitaries

info.label: Scope
info.value: Commemorative anniversary celebration, monumental scenic stage design, live orchestral audio, and banquet production.
